capabilities.title: Three-column desktop shell with independently collapsible and resizable supporting panels
capabilities.contract: The Article remains the central column at viewport height. A responsively collapsed Assistant Panel can always be reopened; it overlays the workspace when the viewport cannot fit the minimum side-by-side layout.

capabilities.title: Focus mode hides both supporting panels without changing Article data
capabilities.contract: Focus mode changes only local layout state.
capabilities.persistence: No Article metadata, Draft, or Revision changes.

capabilities.title: Create, search, select, archive, pin, and list Article groups
capabilities.contract: The Library uses compact two-line Article rows with 2px gaps and 28px context-menu rows for fine pointers, retaining 36px menu rows for coarse pointers. Search has no divider below it and a compact gap before the first Recent heading; Style Profile and Settings use reduced padding with a 36px minimum height. The Archive section stays expanded while its source group contains the selected Article, including restored selections and translations. Selected Article is restored locally, Article activity includes retained Draft checkpoints, and independently selectable translation Articles appear under the selected source group or during search while other source groups show a collapsed-child indicator. The expanded library header and collapsed expand button share the Warplyn spiral icon, using a deeper teal gradient in light appearance and the original mint-to-teal gradient in dark appearance. Context-menu actions pair labels with decorative icons, reusing the header icons for shared actions. Context menus support archive and deletion for a complete source group, while only originals can be pinned and reordered.
capabilities.persistence: Article service persists group archive state and original pin order plus local workspace preferences.

capabilities.title: Persisted conversation, explicit Quick actions, selection scope, streaming, cancellation, and recovery
capabilities.contract: A Lexical composer stores plain author text and one structured skill tag separately; selecting a skill never sends a request, and a tag can run against the whole Article without additional guidance. Clicking unused composer space focuses the editor without overriding its action controls. Selection scope records exact Markdown offsets and a content fingerprint, then requires the same promoted Revision before sending. Deselecting Article text clears that scope and its visible indicator before the next request. The Assistant discovers only classified current-Article capabilities and validates every action against the Author's exact request. Talking Points and Narrative Draft remain available when an Article selection is active, use that selection as their primary Article source, and may use the Author message to guide or extend it. Ordinary generated text remains a Proposal until accepted; an explicitly requested, validated single replacement may use the conversation edit path.
capabilities.persistence: Per-Article Assistant records, minimal capability execution history, explicit Editorial Requests, and a device-local unsent composer draft per Article. Sending or clearing the composer removes its draft.

capabilities.title: Explicit reply replacement and opt-in direct edits
capabilities.contract: Each Article conversation has Propose edits for review or Apply edits directly mode, shown in a compact composer popover selector without persistent explanatory copy; Proposal review is the default and existing conversations retain it. An exact, completed, single replacement from an explicit edit request can be applied once from its reply. An untagged explicit one-character substitution uses the captured Article or selection directly, preserving all other text. Direct mode applies a valid replacement after a separate structured intent check, without creating a Proposal; an invalid replacement fails rather than becoming a review Proposal. Generated capability summaries stay out of chat before the final provenance handoff. Selection scope never expands to the whole Article. Stale Revisions and any current Draft block application with recovery guidance. An applied reply identifies its immutable Assistant Revision; ordinary Proposals retain Proposal Review.
capabilities.persistence: The per-Article mode, validated reply candidate, applied Revision identity, and Revision provenance persist locally in SQLite.

capabilities.title: Author-message conversation checkpoints with Composer restoration
capabilities.contract: Every persisted Author message can restore the active conversation to the moment before it was sent, except while Assistant work is streaming. Confirmation reports rejected work and warns before replacing unsent Composer content. Restoration returns the message text, Skill, target language, and caret to the Composer without recreating an old Article selection. Conversation actions support Left, Right, Home, End, Enter, and Space without changing Workspace focus-area navigation.
capabilities.persistence: The renderer applies conversation, Article, Draft, and Composer state and clears transient request feedback only after the atomic local-service restore succeeds.

capabilities.title: Quiet empty state creates an Article using the configured default language
capabilities.contract: Creation does not create a Revision outside Article creation.

capabilities.title: Title, Revision promotion, focus mode, archive, and confirmed Article deletion
capabilities.contract: Header action buttons use 4px gaps and retain 36px click targets, with visual dividers separating Revision/file actions, archive/delete actions, and focus mode. An archived Article displays an Archived badge beside its title. Metadata changes and archive state do not create a Revision. Archive applies to a source group, and deletion requires confirmation. Deleting an original deletes its translations atomically; deleting a translation preserves its source group.
capabilities.persistence: Article metadata PATCH, group archive and deletion routes, and local target-language guidance.

capabilities.title: Six keyboard-operable Workspace Views with revision-aware actionable and stale badges
capabilities.contract: Each View has stable tab and panel identifiers, labels, and Arrow, Home, and End navigation; actionable and stale Workspace Tab badges use visible text rather than dots, accepted Proposals show no Review badge, and every scrollable supporting View uses the shared quiet scrollbar.
capabilities.persistence: Active View is a local workspace preference; results retain their Article and base Revision.

capabilities.title: Constrained Markdown writing surface with formatting toolbar and safe rich-text paste conversion
capabilities.contract: Article content is persisted as supported Markdown, never editor JSON or raw imported HTML.
capabilities.persistence: Draft lifecycle owns recoverable text persistence.

capabilities.title: Debounced current Draft checkpoints with switch, Settings-entry, and page-hide flushing
capabilities.contract: A Current Draft is mutable, versioned, and never a Revision.
capabilities.persistence: Per-Article Draft checkpoint anchored to the current Revision.

capabilities.title: Explicit promotion of the exact Current Draft checkpoint into one immutable Revision
capabilities.contract: Revision promotion clears only the matching Draft checkpoint and creates one Revision.
capabilities.persistence: Versioned Draft checkpoint and immutable Article Revision.

capabilities.title: Recoverable Draft and Revision conflict resolution without replacing local text implicitly
capabilities.contract: The author explicitly keeps local text, uses the retained Draft, or uses the current Revision.
capabilities.persistence: Conflict responses include current Article and retained Draft data when available.

capabilities.title: Summarized decision-based Proposal review with bulk actions, preservation warnings, fallback, and explicit immutable Revision acceptance
capabilities.contract: AI text stays outside the Article until explicit acceptance. Reliable changes may show non-authoritative Interface-locale summaries whose failure does not block review. Accept all and Reject all select decisions; a separate action applies accepted changes. Accepted Proposals remain visible with read-only decisions after restart. Stale or unreliable Proposals cannot be partially accepted. A stale warning and recovery actions replace decision actions in the review header; preservation warnings remain above patterned diffs in scrolling review content. Labelled change navigation remains reachable outside it and scrolls and focuses the selected change at review start; stale recovery permits dismissal without Article changes. Whole-Proposal fallback discloses its change count.
capabilities.persistence: Completed Proposal content, localized summaries, and the base Revision are recovered from local Assistant and editorial artifact records; accepted Revision provenance links the Proposal artifact and records accepted changes or whole-proposal fallback, and dismissal is a local workspace preference.

capabilities.title: Immutable newest-first Revision history, read-only preview, and confirmed restoration
capabilities.contract: Selecting a Revision from history or the compact Status Bar selector is local-only and opens a read-only preview; restoring creates a new Revision through the existing confirmation and Draft-conflict flow. Revision history mutes and labels Revisions bypassed by the current restore path as Inactive; they remain selectable and restorable, and restoring one recalculates the active path. When the first immutable Revision is empty, history labels it Empty Revision and presents the second saved Revision as Initial Revision while keeping both available.
capabilities.persistence: Immutable Article Revisions and recoverable Draft checkpoints.

capabilities.title: Revision-tied advisory Fact Check and local Style Profile results with stale indication
capabilities.contract: Findings never modify Article text. Fact Check defaults to the current Revision, offers retained runs for historical review, labels partial runs as incomplete, and keeps stale or superseded runs read-only. Unchanged Facts and accepted findings survive Revision updates; changed unresolved Facts become stale. Raw style samples remain local and Article rules remain metadata outside Revision text. Style Profile identifies contributors, rebuild time, applied-rule evidence, and grounded findings.
capabilities.persistence: Completed Editorial artifacts, explicitly incomplete Fact Check runs, and local Style corpus.

capabilities.title: Explicit creation of an independently recoverable linked translation Article
capabilities.contract: New translation… confirms supported target languages, preselecting the viewed language or configured defaults. The dialog identifies the source Article and Revision, explains Draft promotion and preservation of earlier results, and requires renewed review if the source snapshot changes. Generation uses the whole Article. All completed unrejected proposals remain available, with one tab per language and a result selector identifying generation time and source Revision. Initial load selects the latest result for the preferred language; a new completion selects the new result, while failure or cancellation preserves selection. Freshness and protected-span validity belong to the selected result. Creation, refresh, and confirmed rejection target exact result identity. Rejection preserves sibling proposals and accepted history and falls back to another available result. A stale source blocks creation of an independent linked Article. The selected language provides context for grouped Edit, Update, and Reject actions. Edit opens its existing linked Article, including when the proposal is stale, or creates an Article only when no linked translation exists. No repeated linked-Article list or target dropdown appears in the workspace. An Author may explicitly accept a reviewed proposal into a named existing translation as a new immutable Revision, preserving its title and history; source or target Revision changes, rejected or invalid output, mismatched language, and retained target Drafts block acceptance. Update names the target in confirmation; previously created duplicates can be selected there.
capabilities.persistence: Independent Article with source Article and Revision linkage; completed results recover from Assistant messages and artifacts. Selected language is a local workspace preference per Article; older result selection is session-local.

capabilities.title: Article language, explicit Markdown and plain-text copying, and Article-specific character guidance
capabilities.contract: The Status Bar language selector updates metadata without creating a Revision. Copy transfers Markdown by default and offers deterministic plain text. Built-in and custom profiles remain selectable; character limits are guidance only, and the application does not publish directly.
capabilities.persistence: Article language and publishing-profile metadata with persisted default fallbacks.

scenarios.title: One completed selection reply applies exact text once
preconditions: The Author explicitly requests one edit to a selected passage and the Assistant completes one valid replacement.
scenarios.event: The Author clicks Apply to selection on the reply.
expected: Only the captured passage changes and one attributable Revision is appended.
The reply identifies the applied Revision.
forbidden: A second acceptance step, duplicate Revision, or replacement of surrounding Article text.

scenarios.title: Opt-in direct mode requires exact edit intent
preconditions: Apply edits directly mode is active for the Article conversation.
scenarios.event: An Assistant request, with or without a Skill tag, completes with or without explicit edit intent.
expected: An untagged explicit edit request starts the Proposal capability with the captured Article or selection context; a one-character substitution preserves all other text.
Only an explicitly authorized and validated replacement appends a Revision at completion.
forbidden: Mode alone authorizing an unrelated edit, a rejected direct edit becoming a review Proposal, or interim generated text appearing before provenance.

scenarios.title: Constrained layout collapses supporting panels before narrowing the Article Workspace
preconditions: Desktop workspace with both supporting panels requested open
scenarios.event: Viewport becomes narrower than the requested three-column layout.
expected: Assistant Panel collapses before the Article Library Panel
An explicit Assistant Panel expand request overrides temporary responsive collapse
The expanded Assistant Panel overlays the workspace when the minimum side-by-side layout cannot fit
With an explicitly expanded Assistant, widening restores the Library once its side-by-side minimum fits, without reopening it temporarily at the overlay boundary
Article Workspace remains first in keyboard and visual order
forbidden: Persisting temporary responsive collapse as a user preference

scenarios.title: Focus mode hides supporting panels without changing Article state
preconditions: An Article is open in the workspace
scenarios.event: Author enables focus mode.
expected: Only the Article Workspace remains visible
forbidden: Changing Article content, metadata, Draft checkpoints, or Revisions

scenarios.title: Article Library creates and selects Articles while preserving activity order
preconditions: The Article library is loaded
scenarios.event: Author creates or selects an Article.
expected: The current Article updates and local selection is persisted
Recent ordering uses Article or Draft-checkpoint activity
forbidden: Creating a Revision merely by selecting an Article

scenarios.title: Library context actions manage complete Article groups
preconditions: An original Article may have independently editable translations
scenarios.event: Author opens an Article row context menu or uses the Article header archive control.
expected: Archive and unarchive apply to the whole source group without creating Revisions
Only originals can be pinned and reordered, and archived pinned groups retain their order
Deleting an original removes its translations atomically, while deleting a translation preserves its source and siblings
forbidden: A context-menu invocation selecting a different Article
A partial source-group deletion

scenarios.title: Quick action inserts a skill tag and Send remains the sole request trigger
preconditions: An Article is open and Assistant is idle
scenarios.event: Author selects a Quick action then sends, with optional guidance.
expected: The skill tag is inserted into the composer before the request
A selected skill can run against the whole Article without additional guidance
forbidden: Sending an Editorial Request when selecting a Quick action

scenarios.title: Deselecting Article text clears the Assistant request scope
preconditions: An Article area is selected and shown in the Assistant composer
scenarios.event: The author clears the editor selection with the mouse, keyboard, or a focus-changing panel control.
expected: The selection indicator disappears
The next request uses whole-Article scope
forbidden: Sending stale selected text or triggering a request during deselection

scenarios.title: Conversation checkpoints remain keyboard and screen-reader operable
preconditions: The Assistant contains persisted Author messages.
scenarios.event: The Author navigates conversation actions and activates a checkpoint.
expected: Left, Right, Home, and End move through actions and Enter or Space activates the focused checkpoint.
The accessible name identifies the message time and rejected later work, and the confirmation owns focus.
forbidden: A Ctrl-modified navigation scheme or loss of Workspace focus-area behavior.

scenarios.title: Empty workspace creates a new Article with default language
preconditions: No Article is selected
scenarios.event: Author activates Create Article from the empty workspace.
expected: A blank Article becomes current
forbidden: Creating an extra Revision

scenarios.title: Header metadata remains separate from Revision promotion and deletion requires confirmation
preconditions: An Article is current
scenarios.event: Author updates title or requests deletion.
expected: Title persists without a Revision
Deletion requires confirmation
forbidden: Deleting an Article without explicit confirmation

scenarios.title: Every Workspace View has a tab-panel relationship and roving keyboard navigation
preconditions: Article Workspace tab bar is rendered
scenarios.event: Author uses Arrow, Home, or End on a Workspace Tab.
expected: The corresponding View becomes selected and focused
forbidden: Missing tab, panel, or stable identifier for a Workspace View

scenarios.title: Current Article and Workspace View restore from versioned local preferences
preconditions: A valid versioned workspace preference exists
scenarios.event: Workspace reloads.
expected: The saved Article and Workspace View restore
forbidden: Persisting Workspace View into Article history

scenarios.title: Rich-text paste retains supported Markdown and removes unsafe or unsupported content
preconditions: Article Editor is ready for paste
scenarios.event: Author pastes rich text.
expected: Supported semantic Markdown is retained
forbidden: Persisting raw HTML, executable elements, media, or unsafe links

scenarios.title: Editing creates a recoverable Draft checkpoint after idle time
preconditions: Current Article is clean
scenarios.event: Author edits the writing surface and the idle delay elapses.
expected: The Draft becomes checkpointed against the current Revision
forbidden: Creating a Revision during ordinary checkpointing

scenarios.title: Latest Draft text flushes before Article switch, Settings entry, and page hiding
preconditions: Current Article has unsaved local Draft text
scenarios.event: Author switches Article, enters Settings, or hides the page.
expected: Latest text is checkpointed before the context changes
forbidden: Dropping recoverable Draft text

scenarios.title: Older checkpoint completion cannot overwrite a newer local Draft state
preconditions: A checkpoint is in flight
scenarios.event: Author makes another edit before the request completes.
expected: The lifecycle remains dirty for the newer content
forbidden: Displaying the older content as the current checkpoint

scenarios.title: Explicit save promotes only the matching checkpoint into one Revision
preconditions: A Current Draft checkpoint exists
scenarios.event: Author saves the Article as a Revision.
expected: One immutable Revision is created and the matching Draft clears
forbidden: Promoting a mismatched or stale Draft version

scenarios.title: Draft conflict retains local text until author chooses a recovery path
preconditions: A checkpoint or promotion conflicts with newer persisted state
scenarios.event: Server returns Draft or Revision conflict data.
expected: The author can keep local text, use retained Draft text, or use the current Revision
forbidden: Replacing local Draft text without author choice

scenarios.title: Accepted Proposals remain accepted after restart
preconditions: The current Revision was created by accepting a Proposal
scenarios.event: The application restarts and restores Proposal Review.
expected: The Proposal is visibly accepted, its decisions are read-only, no stale warning is shown, and the Proposal tab has no Review badge
forbidden: Reclassifying the accepted Proposal as stale

scenarios.title: Stale Proposals remain reviewable but cannot be accepted
preconditions: Proposal base Revision is no longer current
scenarios.event: Author attempts to accept selected changes.
expected: The stale warning and recovery actions are visible in the review header, review controls remain reachable, and acceptance actions are absent
forbidden: Applying AI-generated text to a newer Article Revision

scenarios.title: Restoring a Revision keeps history immutable and resolves uncommitted Drafts explicitly
preconditions: An earlier Revision is selected
scenarios.event: Author chooses restore and resolves any uncommitted Draft.
expected: A new Revision is created without rewriting existing history
forbidden: Replacing history or silently discarding a Draft

scenarios.title: Findings are Revision-tied advisory output
preconditions: Completed finding output exists
scenarios.event: Author reviews Fact Check or Style Profile output.
expected: Findings retain per-Fact freshness, acceptance state, and source context across Revision updates
forbidden: Changing Article text from advisory output

scenarios.title: Partial Fact Check identifies incomplete coverage
preconditions: A timed-out or partly failed Fact Check retains completed findings.
scenarios.event: The Author opens Fact Check.
expected: Completed findings remain readable with an incomplete-run warning and a recheck action.
forbidden: Unfinished claims presented as checked findings.

scenarios.title: New translation confirms supported targets and the source snapshot
preconditions: An Article is open in Translations.
scenarios.event: The Author cancels or confirms after the source changes.
expected: Cancellation starts no request. Changed source requires renewed review, active requests disable confirmation, and confirmation generates only selected languages.
forbidden: Duplicate generation or generation on opening the dialog.

scenarios.title: Several results in one language support exact-result actions
preconditions: Two completed results exist for the same language.
scenarios.event: The Author selects an older result, creates an Article, or confirms rejection after changing selection.
expected: Selected identity controls creation; rejection uses captured identity. Freshness is per result and removal falls back to another result.
forbidden: Acting on a sibling proposal or resetting selection after failed generation.

scenarios.title: Translation creation is blocked when its source Revision is stale
preconditions: Translation output is based on an older source Revision
scenarios.event: Author attempts to create the linked translation Article.
expected: The stale warning is visible and creation is disabled
forbidden: Overwriting the source Article or creating from stale source content

scenarios.title: A fresh language stays actionable when a sibling proposal is stale
preconditions: Spanish is based on the current source Revision and German on an older Revision.
scenarios.event: The Author switches between language proposals.
expected: Only the stale selected proposal warns and blocks acceptance.
forbidden: A stale sibling disabling a fresh selected proposal.

scenarios.title: Generated translation rejection leaves Article history unchanged
preconditions: A generated translation proposal is awaiting approval
scenarios.event: The author confirms rejection of the translation.
expected: The proposal no longer appears as pending or actionable
The rejection remains distinct from a failed generation
forbidden: Changing the source Article or any accepted translation Revision

scenarios.title: Selected translation language restores locally per Article
preconditions: Completed translations exist for an Article
scenarios.event: Author selects a target language, navigates away, or restarts the workspace.
expected: The selected language restores when its completed translation remains available
An unavailable selection falls back to the latest available translation
forbidden: Showing a selected translation from another Article or changing translation content

scenarios.title: Over-guidance character state remains non-blocking and accessible
preconditions: Publishing text exceeds the selected profile guidance
scenarios.event: Author views the Article Status Bar or uses its Copy control.
expected: Over-guidance state is visible without disabling profile selection or copying
forbidden: Blocking Article editing or direct copy
